newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil resumes oil loadings at Statfjord, Gullfak.
newsitem.headline: Statoil resumes oil loadings at Statfjord, Gullfak.

text.p: Offshore crude loadings at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields resumed early on Thursday after a brief stoppage overnight due to bad weather, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday.
But the weather was expected to deteriorate again sometime later in the day, Statoil said.

"Loadings began again at 8 a.m. (0600 GMT) this morning. We had to stop at 10 p.m. (2000 GMT) last night because of the weather," a spokeswoman for Statoil said. "There is one tanker at Statfjord and one at Gullfaks."
Production at the fields was normal, she said.
"The weather forecast is not very good, we expect to have to stop again later tonight," she said.
North Sea loadings are often disrupted in the winter months due to high winds and swell. The maximum wave height for shuttle tankers to moor up to the offshore buoys is 4.5 metres.
